import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0065 (a b c : ℤ) (hb : b > 0) (hc : c > 0) : a % b ≤ a % c := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0065 (a b c : ℤ) (hb : b > 0) (hc : c > 0) : a % b ≤ a % c := by
  rw [Int.emod_eq_sub_self_emod]
  rw [Int.emod_eq_sub_self_emod]
  apply le_trans
  · apply Int.mul_le_mul_left hb
  · apply Int.mul_le_mul_left hc
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0065 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0065 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0065

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0065
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0065
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
